newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada dollar closes stronger in illiquid market.
newsitem.headline: Canada dollar closes stronger in illiquid market.

text.p: * The Canadian dollar gained strength in a quiet market towards the end of trading Thursday to close at C$1.3375 (US$0.7477) from Wednesday's close at C$1.3405 (US$0.7460).
* Dealers said the market lacked liquidity because Canada's big banks have their fiscal year-end today.
* They said the currency could weaken overnight.
Traders said they expected the currency would weaken as the market becomes more liquid over night.
They said the market will likely turn its focus on U.S. jobs data due out on Friday and its possible impact on the U.S. and Canadian bond market.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar rose to 1.1336 marks from 1.1266 marks at the close on Wednesday, and inched up to 85.15 yen from Wednesday's 85.10 yen.
